description.title: שירות רכב חלופי
description.summary: This table details the terms of service for a replacement vehicle provided as part of a car insurance policy. It outlines availability, communication expectations, and conditions for service.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח לרכב מספקת שירות רכב חלופי, כאשר מוקד השירות זמין בימים ראשון עד חמישי בין השעות 08:00 ל-17:00, בימי שישי ובערבי חג בין השעות 08:00 ל-13:00, וביום כיפור בין השעות 08:00 ל-12:00. מטרת המסמך היא לפרט את זכויות וחובות הלקוח והספק.
description.column_axis: Aspects of the alternative vehicle service
notable_values: Service availability: Fridays and holiday eves 08:00-13:00

sketch:
If expressly noted in the specification that the 'ALTERNATIVE VEHICLE SERVICE DOCUMENT"
is valid, then the following service document provisions shall apply:
This document constitutes the service document between the insured and the alternative vehicle service provider noted in the specification (hereinafter for abbreviation purposes the "service provider") which, in the course of the insurance period will conduct efficient and available communication. This service document details the services to which the insured is entitled, the mutual rights and obligations of the insured and the service provider.
The service center will be available from Sunday to Thursday, from 08:00 to 17:00, on Fridays and holiday eves from 08:00 to 13:00 and on the eve of Yom Kippur from 08:00 to 12:00.
